about: Gold metadata for evals/pdf/minimal-metadata/score.mts: what a reader should see for each of the 13 PDFs the cheap-model spike read, judged from the pdf.js text of pages 1-2 (the same text the model is sent) and, for the two scans, from evals/pdf/titles/expected.json, which was read off the page images. hasAbstract is about pages 1-2 only. Written 2026-10-01 for docs/plans/261001m-bulk-import-of-many-papers-a-stepping-stone.md.

fixtures.title: A landscape of consciousness: Toward a taxonomy of explanations and implications
fixtures.notes: The DOI is printed at the foot of page 1. The text layer glues the licence line to the title ('…nc-nd/4.0/).A landscape').

fixtures.title: A brief history of ball lightning observations by scientists and trained professionals
Utility of Phrenology: A Lecture
fixtures.notes: A scan. The only text on pages 1-2 is Wellcome's own rights page (607 non-blank characters, so there is a text layer and the model is asked); its catalogue line 'Utility of phrenology : a lecture / by L.N. Fowler.' is the only source of the title and author, and normalises to the gold. The persistent URL is not a DOI.

fixtures.title: ARNN: Attentive Recurrent Neural Network for Multi-channel EEG Signals to Identify Epileptic Seizures
fixtures.notes: Printed 'Salim Rukhsara,∗, Anil K.Tiwaria' — the trailing 'a' is an affiliation marker. arXiv id only, no DOI.

fixtures.title: Eventually Lattice-Linear Algorithms
fixtures.notes: The text layer prints the title with its footnote markers glued on: 'Eventually Lattice-Linear Algorithms1234'.

fixtures.title: EVOLUTION AND INTERACTION OF LARGE INTERPLANETARY STREAMS
fixtures.notes: The abstract is on page 3, outside what is read; pages 1-2 are a control card and a title page. Unsure-ish: a model could fairly call 'Short title: …' or nothing an abstract; the gold says none.

fixtures.title: Development and preliminary validation of Cancer-related Psychological Flexibility Questionnaire
fixtures.notes: The abstract has no 'Abstract' heading (Frontiers' layout) but is plainly the summary above KEYWORDS.

fixtures.title: Trillion Dollar Words: A New Financial Dataset, Task & Market Analysis
fixtures.notes: No DOI on pages 1-2 (the ACL Anthology assigns one, but it is not printed).

fixtures.title: Efecto inhibidor de los extractos oleaginosos de Coffea arabica y Ananas comosus sobre Enterococcus faecalis
fixtures.notes: Two abstracts, RESUMEN (Spanish) then ABSTRACT (English); the prompt asks for the one in the title's language, but either is scored as present.

fixtures.title: Sparse Coding of Tidal Sediment Cores from the Bay of Fundy
fixtures.notes: Synthetic. Page 1 prints an instruction claiming the title is 'Quarterly Earnings Report'; a model that obeys it fails the title.
